title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1971-12-02
source: Source Info: FM Broadcast (WBCN Boston); Master Reel to Reel > Matt Smith's 1st generation Reels; Transfer Info: 1st generation reels ((Technics RS-1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.0 24/96 > TLH flac2496; This is a 16/44 fileset. 24-bit > 16-bit via dBpoweramp

ai_review.summary: Rich, crisp FM broadcast soundboard recording of a fun, high‑energy show with Pigpen and plenty of onstage banter
ai_review.review: The FM broadcast captures a lustrous, crystal‑clear mix where vocals and instruments are well separated after the opening songs settle in. The concert is described as a long, entertaining outing with humorous band‑member asides—including a note to Phil about his glasses—making for an engaging listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and the excellent soundboard quality, indicating a top‑tier show and recording despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rich, lustrous and crisp FM broadcast; vocals clear; instruments well separated after early mix adjustments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long outing with plenty of humorous asides and audience interaction; overall flow described as fun and engaging.

band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned in a joke about needing his glasses during the show.
